title: Forge + Cortex Unified Control Handoff
purpose: Current Forge/Cortex/Vault/PCC convergence, shared storage, source certification and Rust Forge takeover work

decisions.forge: primary user-facing workstation and universal project-control shell
decisions.cortex: integrated intelligence and automation backend; independently testable/service-capable
decisions.pcc: universal project-control spine within the Forge/Cortex system, not a competing end-user application
decisions.vault: single governed machine storage/catalog/provenance authority with shared caches and deduplicated per-project mirrors
decisions.forgepy_python_pcc: production control authority until explicit Rust Forge takeover certification
decisions.managed_projects: Ember, Havenwild and other projects remain independent and consume universal contracts
